targets.note: Phone: a folder chosen in the Files sidebar. The body fills the screen with the Back arrow and the place name; the sidebar is gone. The prototype side is its Files place at the same width. A computer shows both.
Phone: the Files sidebar as the list, full width, with no body beside it. On a computer the sidebar sits left of the list.
Phone: the Chats place with a conversation open. Chats draws its own sidebar, so this shows its current phone behaviour for comparison with the prototype's phone.
